    ancestors(a) AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT p FROM scope

    ), descendants(d) AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT OLD."childItemId" FROM scope
      UNION SELECT r."descendantItemId" FROM "bom"."bom_reach" r JOIN scope s ON r."bomType" = s.t AND r."orgId" = s.o WHERE r."ancestorItemId" = OLD."childItemId"
    ), edges AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT e.p, e.c FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT h."bomType" AS t, h."orgId" AS o, r."itemId" AS p, occ."childItemId" AS c
  FROM "bom"."bom_line_occurrence" occ
  JOIN "bom"."bom_line" l ON l."id" = occ."lineId"
  JOIN "bom"."bom_header" h ON h."id" = l."headerId"
  JOIN "bom"."item_revision" r ON r."id" = h."parentRevisionId"
  WHERE occ."flowDirection" = 'consume' AND occ."id" <> OLD."id") e JOIN scope s ON e.t = s.t AND e.o = s.o
    ), visited(a, d, depth) AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT a, a, 0 FROM ancestors
      UNION SELECT v.a, e.c, v.depth + 1 FROM visited v JOIN edges e ON e.p = v.d WHERE v.depth < 128
    )
  SELECT 1 FROM visited v JOIN edges e ON e.p = v.d WHERE v.depth >= 128 LIMIT 1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rxdb:bom_cycle:depth_limit'; END IF;

      AND target."descendantItemId" IN (SELECT d FROM descendants)
      AND (target."ancestorItemId", target."descendantItemId") NOT IN (SELECT v.a, v.d FROM visited v WHERE v.a IS NOT NULL AND v.d IS NOT NULL)
